ignore.reason: Endian, tag, value, size and copy primitives; Rust represents byte order, comparison, hashing, slicing, size arithmetic and copies natively.
Diagnostic producers for C format and codec implementations; Rust consumes diagnostics but does not build them.

Callback implementations installed by bound descriptor initializers (`tlv_fixed_format_init()`, `tlv_fields_format_init()`, `tlv_tagged_fields_format_init()`, `tlv_tagged_binary_format_init()`, `tlv_escaped_format_init()` and `tlv_variable_format_init()`); Core calls them through the descriptor, so Rust has no separate path.
Wrappers that call their bound `_diag` counterpart with a NULL diagnostic; Rust always keeps the structured diagnostic, so they add no separate path.
Tag/Value forms of the single-element write that build a `tlv_element_t` and call `tlv_write_element_diag()`; `write_element()` passes the Element to it directly.
`tlv_writer_write_element()` after the same argument and native-size checks, without diagnostics; `Writer::write_element()` re-encodes through `tlv_writer_write_element_diag()`.
